shot_reference.source: StatsBomb Open Data — FIFA World Cup 2022
shot_reference.coordinate_note: StatsBomb 120x80 normalized to the engine 105x68 frame; approximate normalized metres, not measured stadium dimensions.
shot_reference.split: Every fourth sorted match ID held out before fitting; no shootouts; penalties excluded from geometry fit.
shot_reference.fit_objective: soft-label binomial cross entropy against StatsBomb xG, with sign constraints
